purpose: falsification controls frozen BEFORE discovery; each control must defeat the frozen critical gates. Controls are NOT alternate strategies and CANNOT be promoted, selected on, or used to reset ARC-01 parameters.
evaluation_rule: each control is evaluated on exactly the same window, assets, cost model and gates as the primary discovery; a control that also satisfies ALL critical gates falsifies identification of the claimed mechanism

controls.name: REVERSED_CONTRARIAN_DIRECTION
controls.definition: identical signal instants and eligibility, but the trade direction is REVERSED: SHORT where the primary rule says LONG and vice versa (equivalently direction_sign multiplied by -1)
controls.falsification_target: if trading WITH the crowded side (funding-extreme continuation) also passes all critical gates, the contrarian-unwind claim is not identified and ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL
controls.required_outcome: MUST NOT satisfy all critical gates
controls.note: funding cashflow is re-evaluated with the reversed sign, so the control is also the carry-direction control

controls.name: TEMPORAL_SHIFT_DESTROYING_CAUSAL_ALIGNMENT
controls.definition: two variants, both frozen: (a) decision_time shifted by +8h, (b) decision_time shifted by -8h, i.e. the funding extreme is evaluated against OI/price context that is one settlement out of alignment with it, while every PIT rule is still respected (the shifted decision uses only data <= its own shifted T)
controls.falsification_target: if the mis-aligned variants pass, the observed effect would be attributable to a generic time-of-day/funding-cycle artefact rather than to the extreme-funding+crowding alignment
controls.required_outcome: NEITHER variant may satisfy all critical gates
controls.implementation_note: the shifted decisions are evaluated at the shifted instant's own eligible funding/OI/price state; no re-use of the primary decision's state is permitted

controls.name: FUNDING_ONLY_NO_CROWDING_CONFIRMATION
controls.definition: the OI confirmation leg is removed: trade every extreme-funding decision that passes the funding transform (z >= +2.0 => SHORT, z <= -2.0 => LONG), with identical entry/exit/cost/funding-cashflow rules
controls.falsification_target: if funding alone passes all critical gates, the crowding confirmation is NOT load-bearing: the composite is indistinguishable from the funding-only family already refuted as a standalone edge (FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #8), so ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL
controls.required_outcome: MUST NOT satisfy all critical gates

controls.name: DETERMINISTIC_DIRECTION_NULL
controls.definition: identical signal instants (same eligibility filter), but the direction is replaced by a deterministic pseudo-random direction drawn from a frozen hash: direction = LONG if SHA256(f'{NULL_SEED}:{asset}:{decision_time_ms}') first byte is even, else SHORT, with NULL_SEED = 20260915; funding cashflow follows the null direction
controls.falsification_target: quantifies the expected outcome of the same holding/cost/cashflow machinery under a direction-less null; a passing null would indicate a mechanical artefact (e.g. zero-cost carry harvesting) rather than a directional edge
controls.required_outcome: MUST NOT satisfy all critical gates
controls.determinism: reproducible from the frozen seed; no runtime RNG

secondary_diagnostics.definition: the full reason-code histogram of NO_SIGNAL decisions (frozen precedence order)
the primary trade set re-measured with funding cashflow removed
secondary_diagnostics.role: separates the unwind leg from the carry leg; also a CRITICAL gate in its own right (see statistical gates)

secondary_diagnostics.definition: gross, funding-cashflow, cost and net components reported per asset and pooled

no_parameter_reuse_across_controls: a control outcome may never be used to adjust ARC-01 thresholds, lookbacks, holding period, assets or cadence
